commands.title: Modkit: Open Active File in Workbench

modkit.extensions.markdownDescription: Extension directories to load beside the ones that ship with this build. Each item is either a path, or an object with `path`, an optional `id` the directory is expected to declare, and an optional `enabled` flag. Directories named here are loaded as installed artifacts and never run in the extension host process.

modkit.disabledContributions.markdownDescription: Contribution ids to switch off, one level below `modkit.extensions`: an extension may ship several codecs and you may want only some of them. A disabled contribution stays in the inventory and loses activation, so a file only it could read opens as raw bytes with the diagnostic `x3.host/contribution-disabled` — and the switch is still there to turn it back on. Takes effect when the window reloads.
